title: EPPC-CARE: Staged Hierarchical Annotation of Communication Behaviors in Secure Patient-Provider Messages
abstract: arXiv:2611.34539v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Objectives: Patient portal messages provide invaluable information about communication dynamics between patients and healthcare providers, but extracting it manually is labor-intensive. We developed and evaluated EPPC-CARE, an automated framework for identifying communication behaviors together with the supporting text for each classification. Materials and Methods: From 867 messages, we obtained 5,516 reference standard annotations. Each annotation is a triplet of communication-related text (span), a broader communication category (Code), and a specific subcategory (Sub-code). We evaluated EPPC-CARE's identified triplets across six open-weight large language models (LLMs) against supervised fine-tuning and communication-based models such as EPPC-OASIS. We also compared EPPC-CARE with human expert annotations on 100 messages. Results: EPPC-CARE improved performance over EPPC-OASIS across all six models. EPPC-CARE's Triplet F1 improved

translated_title: EPPC-CARE：医患安全门户消息中沟通行为的分阶段分层标注
translated_abstract: 目标：患者门户消息提供了关于患者与医疗提供者之间沟通动态的宝贵信息，但人工提取这些信息非常耗费人力。我们开发并评估了EPPC-CARE，一个用于识别沟通行为并同时给出每次分类所支持文本的自动化框架。材料与方法：从867条消息中，我们获得了5,516条参考标准标注。每条标注都是一个三元组，包含沟通相关文本（文本片段）、较宽泛的沟通类别（Code）以及具体的子类别。我们在六个开源权重大语言模型（LLMs）上评估了EPPC-CARE识别的三元组，并与监督微调方法及基于沟通的模型（如EPPC-OASIS）进行比较。我们还在100条消息上将EPPC-CARE的输出与人类专家标注进行了对比。结果：EPPC-CARE在所有六个模型上的表现均优于EPPC-OASIS，其三元组F1分数有所提升（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: EPPC-CARE是一个基于开源大语言模型的自动化分层标注框架，能从医患门户消息中识别沟通行为并输出“文本片段—沟通类别—子类别”三元组，性能全面超越EPPC-OASIS和监督微调方法，且接近人类专家标注水平。
en_tdlr: EPPC-CARE is an automated staged hierarchical annotation framework that identifies communication behaviors in patient-provider portal messages as triplets (span, code, sub-code), outperforming EPPC-OASIS and supervised fine-tuning across six open-weight LLMs while approaching human expert-level annotation quality.
